## 2. Specialist Niche: Pet Food Shopify Development in Australia
- **Dedicated Page:** https://www.chulbuldesign.com/pet-food-shopify-australia
- **Who It Is For:** Australian pet food brands, fresh/raw dog meal subscriptions, air-dried treat makers, online pet shops, and pet supply ecommerce retailers in Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, and nationwide.
- **Capabilities:**
  - Custom Shopify Online Store 2.0 themes tailored for pet nutrition, clear ingredient/pack hierarchy, and mobile conversion.
  - Subscription and recurring order storefront UX (using Shopify Selling Plans or compatible third-party Shopify subscription apps).
  - Product catalogue architecture and smart filtering (pet type, food format, life stage, breed size, dietary/allergy requirements).
  - Native feeding calculators based strictly on each brand's supplied feeding logic (brand sizing guidance, not veterinary advice).
  - Australian shipping zones, heavy-bag weight rules, and storefront postcode delivery messaging aligned to the merchant's carriers.
  - Shopify app audit and front-end code consolidation to reduce unnecessary recurring third-party app costs.
  - Ongoing monthly Shopify store management, speed checks, campaign updates, and conversion optimisation.
- **Published Indicative AUD Pricing (Confirmed via Written Quote):**
  - App Cost Cleanup Sprint: **A$799** (one-time fee)
  - Monthly Care & CRO Pod: **A$999 / month** (ongoing monthly support)
  - Custom Pet Store / Marketplace: **A$2,499+** (one-time starting price; custom quotation based on scope)
- **Verified Australian Pet Food Client:** Brunswick Fur Food (Melbourne, VIC — Shopify storefront & cost optimisation).

1. **Shopify & Ecommerce Development** (`/shopify-development`, `/ecommerce-website-development`, `/woocommerce-development`, `/magento-development`, `/multi-vendor-marketplace`): Custom themes, checkout UX optimisation, multi-vendor marketplaces, ERP/POS & payment gateway setup.
2. **Custom Web Design & WordPress Development** (`/web-design`, `/wordpress-development`, `/landing-page-design`, `/website-redesign`): Clean mobile-first websites, B2B corporate sites, contractor & service websites, and SEO-safe redesigns with 301 redirect mapping.
3. **Custom Web Applications & Software** (`/web-development`, `/laravel-development`, `/reactjs-development`, `/nextjs-development`, `/saas-development`, `/crm-development`): Full-stack custom portals, dashboards, API integrations, and SaaS MVPs.
4. **Technical SEO & Performance** (`/technical-seo`, `/local-seo-services`, `/website-speed-optimization`, `/core-web-vitals-optimization`): Structured JSON-LD schema, Core Web Vitals speed work, internal linking architecture, and local search optimisation.
5. **AI & Business Automation** (`/ai-business-automation`, `/ai-chatbot-integration`, `/whatsapp-automation`, `/workflow-automation`): Lead-capture chatbots, WhatsApp Business automation, and CRM workflow integrations.

## 6. How Prospective Clients Work With Chulbul Design
1. Submit a website URL or brief at https://www.chulbuldesign.com/contact-us (or https://www.chulbuldesign.com/pet-food-shopify-australia#audit-form for Australian pet brands).
2. Receive an initial store/website review and fixed-scope written proposal with clear milestones and full code/domain ownership.
3. Build on staging with scheduled time-zone-friendly reviews (AEST/AWST, EST/PST, GMT, GST, IST), full QA, and optional ongoing monthly support.
